dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: A network of irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures characterized by thin, high-intensity perimeters. These structures show a sharp gradient transition from a deep dark exterior to a narrow, high-luminance boundary, enclosing a slightly less dark interior compared to the base coat.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate spatial density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters, appearing as small disconnected specks primarily concentrated in the anterior-dorsal region and interspersed between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent ring structures form an irregular, elongated polygon extending along the dorsal midline, with an obtuse triangle formed by the three most central centroids in the mid-body region.
